description.raw: '''Active:''' '''LeBlanc''' flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy it hits and forms a [[File:Focused Resolve.png|20px|link=Tether|An icon representing the keyword Tether]] [[:Tether|tether]] between '''LeBlanc''' and the target for 1.5 seconds, during which they are [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealed]].
description.text: Active: LeBlanc flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy it hits and forms a tether between LeBlanc and the target for 1.5 seconds, during which they are revealed.

description2.raw: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, it fractures to deal magic damage to the target and [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|root]] them for 1.5 seconds, during which they are [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealed]].
description2.text: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, it fractures to deal magic damage to the target and root them for 1.5 seconds, during which they are revealed.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 (+ 40% AP)

leveling2.raw:
'''Fracture Magic Damage:'''
80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 (+ 85% AP)
'''Total Damage:'''
130 / 190 / 250 / 310 / 370 (+ 125% AP)

notes.raw: * Both the initial and the delayed damage can detonate [[File:LeBlanc Sigil of Malice.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Sigil of Malice|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Sigil of Malice]] [[LeBlanc#Sigil of Malice|Sigil of Malice]]. * ''Ethereal Chains'' and [[File:LeBlanc Mimic- Ethereal Chains.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Mimic: Ethereal Chains|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Mimic: Ethereal Chains]] [[LeBlanc#Mimic: Ethereal Chains|Mimic: Ethereal Chains]] are separate debuffs, and can both be tethered to the same target without overriding each other. The [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|root]] duration for either one are unchanged. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied. * The tether remains for a minimum of 0.25 seconds regardless of distance. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
Both the initial and the delayed damage can detonate Sigil of Malice.
Ethereal Chains and Mimic: Ethereal Chains are separate debuffs, and can both be tethered to the same target without overriding each other. The root duration for either one are unchanged.
Spell shield will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
The tether remains for a minimum of 0.25 seconds regardless of distance.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
